directive.name: github
directive.description: Full GitHub team workflow. Replaces git.xml — owns ALL git and GitHub operations. Teams of 10-30: Issues for tracking, draft PRs at plan, WIP pushes, review-gated merges. Task artifacts (task.xml, spec.xml, plan.xml) live only on the task branch — never on main. They are deleted before merge. Main only receives implementation code. Requires GitHub MCP server.

context.principle: Branch names use type prefix from task label: feat/{id}, fix/{id}, refactor/{id}, docs/{id}. Type is derived from the label's commit-type in workflow.yaml (default: feat). Quick tasks use quick/{id}. Branch is created at create phase, not scope.
Task artifacts (task.xml, spec.xml, plan.xml) live only on the task branch. They are deleted before merge. Main only receives implementation code. GitHub Issues are the team's view into task state.
All merges through GitHub PRs (squash). Never merge locally to main.
Every task syncs to a GitHub Issue for team visibility.
Every save pushes. Draft PR reflects WIP automatically.
PR body includes "Closes #N" to auto-close the linked issue.
Draft PR at plan phase. Stays draft — user publishes and merges in GitHub UI.
GitHub MCP tools: mcp__GitHub__issue_write, mcp__GitHub__issue_read, mcp__GitHub__create_pull_request, mcp__GitHub__pull_request_read, mcp__GitHub__add_issue_comment.
Squash merge only. Artifacts (added then deleted on branch) net to zero on main. User merges via GitHub UI — artifacts never leak with squash. Configure repo to allow/default squash merge.

process.rule: 1. Verify on main: git branch --show-current. If not, error and exit. 2. Derive branch type from task label's commit-type in workflow.yaml: feature→feat, bug→fix, refactor→refactor, docs→docs. Default: feat. Branch name: {type}/{id} (e.g., feat/022-add-dark-mode, fix/023-login-bug). 3. Create branch: git checkout -b {type}/{id} Add github-branch="{type}/{id}" to task element in task.xml. 4. Stage and commit task.xml (and any stub docs): git add .festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml {newDocPaths} git commit -m "docs({id}): create - {title}" 5. Sync to GitHub Issue: IF $ARGUMENTS is an issue number (#N): Fetch via mcp__GitHub__issue_read, add github-issue="#N" and github-url to task.xml. ELSE: Create via mcp__GitHub__issue_write (title: task title, body: task.xml in xml fence, labels: [task label mapped to GitHub label], assignees: [authenticated user]). Add github-issue="#N" and github-url to task.xml. Amend commit: git add .festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml && git commit --amend --no-edit 6. git push -u origin {type}/{id}

1. Read github-branch from task.xml. Verify current branch matches. If not, error and exit. 2. Commit and push: git add .festinalente/tasks/{id}/spec.xml .festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml git commit -m "docs({id}): scope - {title}" git push 3. Comment on GitHub Issue with full spec: mcp__GitHub__add_issue_comment — body: "## Scoped

Branch: `{github-branch}`

```xml
{spec.xml contents}
```"
1. Read github-branch from task.xml. Verify current branch matches. If not, error and exit. 2. Do NOT commit. Code stays uncommitted until save or finalize.

1. Read github-branch from task.xml. Verify current branch matches. If not, error and exit. 2. Check for changes: git status && git diff --name-only. If none, warn and exit. 3. Stage, commit, push: git add {changed files} .festinalente/tasks/{id}/plan.xml git commit -m "wip({id}): {progress summary}" git push

1. Read github-branch from task.xml. Verify current branch matches. If not, error and exit. 2. Check for uncommitted changes. Display files. If none, ask whether to proceed. 3. Determine commit type from task label via workflow.yaml: bug→fix, feature→feat, docs→docs, refactor→refactor. Default: feat. 4. Commit: git add {files} .festinalente/ && git commit -m "{type}({id}): {title}" 5. If directive check failed and auto-fixed: git add {files} && git commit -m "docs({id}): check-retry - {title}" Restart all checks. 6. After doc updates, commit docs: git add .festinalente/product/ .festinalente/engineering/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml git commit -m "docs({id}): {product|engineering|product+engineering} - {summary}" 7. git push

STATE CHECK — read github-pr from task.xml:
NO github-pr (plan was skipped): Create PR via mcp__GitHub__create_pull_request (not draft), head: {github-branch}. Add github-pr to task.xml, commit, push.
HAS github-pr — check via mcp__GitHub__pull_request_read: state="merged" → Output "PR already merged. Task complete." EXIT. state="closed" → Prompt "PR closed. Create new?" then create. mergeable=false → Rebase onto main and push: git fetch origin main git rebase origin/main git push --force-with-lease Then re-check PR state.
THEN proceed to GH-FIN-MERGE (delete artifacts, push, instruct user).

1. Update task status="done", add completed date. git add .festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml git commit -m "docs({id}): done - {title}" 2. Remove task artifacts from branch: git rm -r .festinalente/tasks/{id}/ git commit -m "chore({id}): cleanup - {title}" 3. git push 4. Output: "Ready to merge: https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{N} Publish the draft and squash-merge. Issue #{github-issue} will auto-close." 5. EXIT.

1. Read github-branch from task.xml. Verify current branch matches. If not, error and exit. 2. Commit and push: git add .festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml .festinalente/tasks/{id}/plan.xml git commit -m "docs({id}): rework - {title}" git push 3. If github-pr exists: comment on PR with rework reason via mcp__GitHub__add_issue_comment.

1. Read task.xml from the task branch (use git show {branch}:.festinalente/tasks/{id}/task.xml if not on the branch). Extract github-pr, github-issue, github-branch. 2. If not on main: git checkout main 3. GitHub cleanup: If github-pr: close PR with comment "Task deleted." If github-issue: close issue via mcp__GitHub__issue_write (state: "closed"). If remote branch exists: git push origin --delete {github-branch} If local branch exists: git branch -D {github-branch} 4. No commit needed — task files only existed on the deleted branch.

1. Verify on main. If not, error and exit. 2. Create branch: git checkout -b quick/{id} (error if exists). 3. After implementation: git add . && git commit -m "quick({id}): {title}" 4. After quick.xml update: git add .festinalente/quick/{id}/quick.xml && git commit --amend --no-edit 5. After doc updates (if any): git add .festinalente/product/ .festinalente/engineering/ .festinalente/quick/{id}/ && git commit --amend --no-edit 6. Push: git push -u origin quick/{id} 7. Create PR: mcp__GitHub__create_pull_request — title: "quick({id}): {title}", head: quick/{id}, base: main. Output: "PR ready: https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{N} — squash-merge in GitHub UI." EXIT.
git add .festinalente/product/ git commit -m "docs: define-product - {description}" && git push
git add .festinalente/product/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml git commit -m "docs: map-product - {summary}" && git push
git add .festinalente/engineering/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml git commit -m "docs: map-engineering - {summary}" && git push
git add .festinalente/directives/{name}.xml .festinalente/config.yaml git commit -m "docs: create directive - {name}" && git push

check.item: GitHub MCP server is connected (mcp__GitHub__* tools available)
Repository has remote origin with push access
Commits use conventional format: type(scope): description
No uncommitted changes remain (unless implement phase)
GitHub issue linked (github-issue attribute on task)

example.code:
# Branch created at CREATE (not scope): # label="feature" → feat/022-add-dark-mode # label="bug" → fix/023-login-redirect
# task.xml (lives on branch only, never main): <task id="022-add-dark-mode" status="backlog" github-issue="#42" github-branch="feat/022-add-dark-mode">

# Full commit history (all on feat/022-add-dark-mode): docs(022-add-dark-mode): create - Add dark mode toggle docs(022-add-dark-mode): scope - Add dark mode toggle docs(022-add-dark-mode): plan - Add dark mode toggle docs(022-add-dark-mode): draft pr created - Add dark mode toggle wip(022-add-dark-mode): completed toggle and theme provider feat(022-add-dark-mode): Add dark mode toggle docs(022-add-dark-mode): product+engineering - dark mode docs docs(022-add-dark-mode): done - Add dark mode toggle chore(022-add-dark-mode): cleanup - Add dark mode toggle # ↑ deletes task.xml, spec.xml, plan.xml before merge

# WRONG: committing task files to main git checkout main git add .festinalente/tasks/022/task.xml # CORRECT: task files live on branch only
# WRONG: local merge git checkout main && git merge feat/022-add-dark-mode --no-ff # CORRECT: merge via GitHub UI (squash)
